[[File:Emberlene_Memorial_Shrine.jpg|thumb|260px|An Emberlene memorial shrine in the [[Mistryl Safehouse|Mistryl safe house]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]]]
'''Emberlene memorial shrines''' were built by the people that had left their home world of [[Emberlene]] after it had been razed. Refugees of Emberlene like the members of the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] would seek out these shrines to remember their former home and leave offerings. Most such memorial shrines were stocked with [[Emberlene Essence]], a musky fragrance that evoked memories of Emberlene's deep woods.<ref name="SWG:CE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Cam'doen's Enforcer|Naboo}}</ref>

One such memorial shrine could be found in a [[Mistryl Safehouse|safe house]] of the Mistryl Shadow Guard outside of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:CE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an agent of the [[Azure Cabal]] broke into the house and stole a bottle of Emberlene Essence from the shrine.<ref name="SWG:CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
An Emberlene memorial shrine appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Emberlene memorial shrine was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
